in_marathi.name: Karishma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karishma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Kaara’ (Desire) and ‘Shma’ (Love), Karishma is a name evoking the goddess of love and desire, Parvati. It carries the essence of the divine feminine and embodies the power of attraction and passion.
